nodes.name: microbial_decomposition
nodes.description: Microbial-explicit SOM decomposition and soil respiration

nodes.name: Grant_Rubisco_C3_Kinetics
nodes.description: C3 gross CO2 fixation from Grant-1989 Rubisco kinetics with Arrhenius low/high-T inactivation; Ci solved by fixed-point iteration.

nodes.name: PEP_C4_Refixation
nodes.description: Two-compartment C4 pathway: PEP carboxylation in mesophyll then bundle-sheath re-fixation.

nodes.name: Turgor_Based_Stomatal_Stress
nodes.description: Stomatal stress = exp(-PSICanopyTurg/RCS) — turgor-driven, solved via CO2 diffusion; not Ball-Berry/Medlyn.

nodes.name: Canopy_Radiative_Transfer
nodes.description: Leaf optical properties + clumping + inclination set canopy light interception.

nodes.name: Node_Leaf_Phenology
nodes.description: Node initiation + leaf appearance rates with chilling/photoperiod gating across an 11-stage plant calendar.

nodes.name: Stage_Prescribed_Allocation
nodes.description: Hard-coded partition fractions across 5 growth stages (e.g. 0.725 leaf / 0.275 petiole pre-floral-init) in CalcPartitionCoeff.

nodes.name: MichaelisMenten_Nutrient_Uptake
nodes.description: Root uptake of NH4/NO3/H2PO4 by Michaelis-Menten (max rate, half-saturation Km, minimum concentration).

nodes.name: Symbiotic_N2_Fixation
nodes.description: Symbiotic N2 fixation gated by the INTYP flag; supplies nodule N.

nodes.name: Prescribed_Tissue_Stoichiometry
nodes.description: Prescribed organ N:C and P:C ratios setting tissue nutrient demand and litter quality.

nodes.name: Root_Hydraulic_Architecture
nodes.description: Root radii, porosity, and radial/axial hydraulic resistivity — set root water/nutrient transport and the root water-potential profile.
nodes.code_location: f90src/IOutils/PlantInfoMod.F90:584-591 (Root1stMaxRadius/Root2ndMaxRadius/RootPorosity/RootRadialResist/RootAxialResist); consumed in the root water-uptake solver.

nodes.name: Root_Growth_Allocation
nodes.description: Root branching frequency and the shoot-root nonstructural-C economy that funds new root growth.

nodes.name: Root_Vertical_Profile
nodes.description: NON-CALIBRATABLE. Root vertical distribution is a hard-coded Jackson-1997 beta table indexed by a discrete biome type — there is no per-PFT continuous knob.
nodes.code_location: f90src/Prescribed_pheno/PrescribePhenolMod.F90:320-363 (SetRootProfileZ: real,parameter :: beta(10) at :343, indexed by irootType); irootType from ATS coupling or hard-coded=1 at :209.

nodes.name: Plant_Functional_Type_Switches
nodes.description: Integer PFT switches that select whole pathways (C3/C4, growth habit, turnover, phenology type, thermal zone).

nodes.name: Heterotroph_Aerobic_Catabolism
nodes.description: Monod DOC/acetate uptake by aerobic bacteria/fungi, O2-limited, aggregated into net soil-microbial CO2 production.

nodes.name: Microbial_Maintenance_Respiration
nodes.description: Baseline biomass-proportional CO2 'tax' independent of growth, Arrhenius temperature-scaled.

nodes.name: Microbial_Mortality_Recycling
nodes.description: Dead-biomass flux splits between recycled-into-biomass (stays out of the CO2 pathway) and litterfall/humus (re-enters decomposition, eventually respired).

nodes.name: Growth_Efficiency_Energetics
nodes.description: Empirical free-energy yields set microbial carbon-use efficiency (fraction of catabolized C lost to CO2 vs. retained for growth).

nodes.name: SOM_Hydrolysis
nodes.description: Rate-limited breakdown of solid SOM (litter/POM/humus) into DOC, gated by a DOC-inhibited Monod saturation on bulk SOC.

nodes.name: Necromass_Hydrolysis
nodes.description: Breakdown of dead microbial residue (necromass) into DOC, same DOC-inhibited Monod scalar as SOM hydrolysis.

nodes.name: DOM_Sorption_Desorption
nodes.description: Linear (Henry-type) sorption-desorption exchange between dissolved and sorbed OM.
